name: Halgar's Summons
summary: In Undercity, Halgar's Summons calls promising Forsaken warlocks to advanced training. Carendin Halgar awaits those who have mastered the first fel arts in the Magic Quarter, where dangerous beings from the Nether test their skill.

sections.title: A Master's Notice
sections.body: A warlock's command of basic fel energies earns notice in Brill or the Tirisfal wilderness. Ageron Kargal, a senior practitioner who recognizes talent, sends word to those who show promise. Carendin Halgar's summons is a rare privilege and a perilous step in a warlock's training. Basic imps and petty curses no longer suffice.

sections.title: The Magic Quarter
sections.body: Carendin Halgar oversees warlock rites in Undercity's Magic Quarter, near the Temple of the Damned. Forsaken darkcasters lack the moral restraint of the living, but summoning across the planes still demands discipline. Halgar tolerates neither hesitation nor sentiment. Those called to him are expected to show deference and face the hostile horrors of the Twisting Nether.

faq.answer: Carendin Halgar is Undercity's chief warlock trainer, in the Magic Quarter. He guides Forsaken summoners in the dark arts and tests their resolve before teaching them to bind powerful Nether creatures.
Ageron Kargal, a seasoned warlock trainer in Brill, sends you to Halgar after learning that the master has taken a personal interest in your progress.

faq.q: Where can I find Carendin Halgar in Undercity?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar is in Undercity's Magic Quarter, near the Temple of the Damned.

aliases: why do i need this quest
what does halgars summons lead to
faq.answer: The summons marks your passage from basic spellcasting to the peril of subduing demons. It begins the trials required to bind a Voidwalker to your service.

faq.q: Is Halgar willing to teach anyone?
faq.answer: Halgar gives his attention to promising warlocks. He has little patience for idle pleasantries and expects every apprentice brought before him to have proven capable with volatile fel arts.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Halgar?
faq.answer: When you report to Halgar, he tests your magic by sending you to gather the components needed to summon and bind an otherworldly shadow minion.

angles.text: As a warlock, you leave elementary training behind and face planar enslavement under Undercity's foremost master of the dark arts.
As Forsaken, you pursue shadow and fel with ruthless ambition. Halgar's sanctum reflects your people's practical disregard for the living's caution.
